ISLND

WASD
Control your character.
Left thumb
Walk.
Space
Jump. Tap twice to fly.
Shift
Sprint, or fly down.
Mouse
Look around.
Left click
Break a block.
Right click
Place a block, or use a door, bed, lever or button.
Middle click
Copy the block you look at.
1–0, Wheel
Choose a block.
B
Open the block picker.
E
Board, ride, adopt, talk and use.
T
Your pet’s power.
G
Your pet’s second power.
Y
Your pet does a trick.
V
First or third person.
M
Island map.
P
Float up to the Sky Palace.
Q
Fish from a dock.
Z
Spyglass.
C
Grappling hook.
X
Emotes and reactions.
N
Scatter pigeon seed.
O
Photo mode.
H J K
Helicopter rope, let go, bridge.
F
Fire a torpedo.
U
Trident wave.
R
Back to the start.
Enter
Chat.
/
Type a command.
Esc
Pause.
Right thumb
Look around.
Buttons
Jump, break, place, fly, view and board.
Hotbar
Pick a block, or + for every block.

Everything else

One island, one wide flat meadow. Dig, stack and build whatever you like.

Play together

    Around the island

    Flying machines
    Slime carries what touches it. /machine builds one.
    Minecarts
    E on a rail. W pushes. Powered rails boost.
    Spark doors
    Power one block and the whole door opens.
    Daylight sensor
    Gives spark power at night.
    Jumbo trolley
    E by the trolley for a snack. 4 coins.
    Cargo hold
    E on a jet ski by the parked jumbo.
    Air show
    8:30pm to 9:30pm over the meadow.
    Pilot licence
    Land the jumbo on the runway.
    Pet levels
    Tricks, powers and time together. Up to 5.
    Pet race
    /petrace, then 1–5 to bet 5 coins.
    Gruff’s lookout
    Beside Gruff’s peak. Goat owners only.
    Seasons
    Snow, blossom, leaves. /season to try one.
    Bonfire night
    Fireworks all evening on 5 November.
    Lightning
    Storms strike TNT and wire.
    Night market
    After dark on the meadow. Glow blocks, 10 coins.
    Treasure
    The Gazette’s X. Dig there once a day.
    Hide and seek
    Host starts it in a room. /hide
    Build battle
    /battle. 3 minutes, then vote with 1–9.
    Display block
    Shows spark power as 0 to F.
    Elevator pad
    Power it and step on. Up to the ceiling.
    Conveyor belt
    Powered belts carry you along.
    Paint bucket
    Repaints a whole patch the next colour.
    Blueprints
    /copy, then /blueprint. Paste a code to load.
    Beat block
    Pulses spark power on the beat.
    Mini Isle
    West sea. Palms, blossom and a lantern path to the falls.
    Message in a bottle
    /bottle hello, by the sea. E on a beach bottle.
    Account
    Pause card. Username and password keep your save.
    Slinky
    Big black snake with wings. Flies beside you.
    Your house
    Owners can break any block of their home.
    Rusty the fox
    On the Mini Isle. T to pounce.
    Slot 0
    Your item: 0 to hold it, 0 again for the next.
    Swords & armour
    Wood to spark. Craft at a crafting table.
    Survival / creative
    /gamemode survival or creative. Or in Settings.
    Crafting
    B then Crafting (2×2), or a crafting table (3×3).
    Shield
    Craft one. Hold right click to block.
    Grenades
    Left click to lob one. It goes off 2.5 seconds later.
    Throwing knives
    Left click to throw. Walk over them to pick up.
    Spear
    Reaches further. Hold right click to throw it.
    Bow
    Hold right click to draw, let go to shoot.
    Fire arrows
    Craft with coal. Set wood, TNT and people alight.
    Rope
    Right click someone to pull them. /tie Name, /untie.
    Spark dust
    Purple chests in the owls’ lab.
    Golden owl
    Lab secret room. E for a wish: Midas touch.
    B&M HQ
    Under the Mini Isle runway. Paw print: secret room.
    Floating potato
    Biscuit or Mochi ride it when you fly.
    Cherry blossom
    Break some off a cherry tree to unlock it.
    Admins
    /pet Name mochi, /kill Name.
    Coco the chimp
    Tree den in the Mini Isle woods. T: climb walls.
    Island Shuttle
    Biplane. North Shore to the Mini Isle. E to board.
    Owl Hopper
    Owls only. Mini Isle, Sky Palace, Owl Island. F to fly it.
    Owl Island
    E by the stork for a sabotage job.
    Hot-air balloon
    Meadow corner. Space burner, Shift vent.
    Speedboat race
    On a jet ski: /boatrace. Eight buoys.
    Railway
    On the ground, round all four docks. E by the track.
    Cabin crew
    On the jumbo: /crew, /pa, /demo.
    Pet house
    E with your pet. It moves in.
    Pet friends
    Pets dance when they meet. XP.
    Rainbow
    Over the cottage after rain. Touch it: a hook for 5 min.
    Aurora
    Winter nights, to the north.
    Tides
    Low tide brings out crabs. /tide
    Festival
    Weekends. Ferris wheel and stalls.
    Mystery cave
    A purple portal. New every week.
    Polly’s quests
    Three a day. /quests
    Letters
    /letter Name hi. A pigeon takes it.
    Disco
    Campsite at night. E at the decks.
    Teams
    /team red, /team base, /team deposit 10
    Gifts
    /gift Name 10, or hat pirate, or glow.
    Settings
    Volume, view, mouse, blocky shapes, game mode. On this page.
    Badges
    On this page, at the bottom.
    Pet powers
    T. Lift, dash, fly, or turn into food.
    Second powers
    G. Owl Eyes, Frost Wings, Lucky Fin, fire.
    Doors and beds
    Right click to open, shut or sleep.
    Water
    Right click pours. Left click scoops.
    E
    Board, adopt, ride, talk, use.
    On the jumbo
    WASD walk. E sit. Business is upstairs.
    Spark wire
    Aim at the strip to hit it.
    Fishing
    Q on a dock. Reel in when it dips.
    Sky Palace
    East, high up. Owl Hopper only.
    Helicopter
    E at North Shore. H rope, J let go, K bridge.
    Jet skis
    E at the campsite jetty.
    Cable car
    E at the summit or the cottage.
    Signs
    Right click a sign to change it.
    Parachute
    Space while falling.
    Commands
    /help lists them all.
    Emotes
    X, then 1–5. 6–0 for reactions.
    Secret lab
    Owl owners. Under the Mini Isle: through the waterfall.
    Atlantis
    Break the temple floor, dive the sub on it, or use the infiltrator. U for a wave.
    Torpedoes
    F in the submarine.
    Redstone
    Right click levers and buttons.
    Bird Air Express
    /tp express. E to fly it.
    Sky course
    E on the meadow’s glowing pad.
    Pet hotel
    /hotel beside Pemberton.
    Submarine
    E at West Bay. Space up, Shift down.
    Capture the flag
    /ctf start. First to 3.
    Bazza’s Taxis
    E by Bazza. 5 coins.
    Lava
    Don’t stand in it.
    Volcano
    /tp volcano. E to meet Ember.
    Shipwreck
    /tp wreck. The ghost comes at night.
    Island Nations
    /tp un. E at the podium.
    Slinky
    Under the treehouse. Owl powers.
    B&M HQ
    The hatch in the lighthouse floor.
    Island Shop
    E by Polly to spend coins.
    Trampoline
    Hold Space to bounce higher.
    Bazza
    E at the cottage gate.
    Pemberton
    B by him in the treehouse hall.
    Zip lines
    E under the line. Space lets go.
